purpose.text: Use Google Analytics 4 and Search Console to analyze a configured website’s traffic, content performance, audiences, engagement, conversions, revenue, and search performance. Support current activity snapshots, date-range comparisons, GA4 field discovery, and targeted page lookups. Inspect URLs and submit requested re-crawl or removal notifications. Save analysis results and use the saved data to prepare Markdown summaries.
